LanguageData.LP_ChromaticDragons.label: chromatic dragons
LanguageData.LP_ChromaticDragons.description: The red, blue, green, black and white chromatic dragons and the Cult of the Dragon that worships them. Each rules alone and never allies with the others, yet all are equally greedy and equally hostile to anyone who won't bow.
LanguageData.LP_ChromaticDragons.ideoDescription: Dragons are the true masters of the world. Those who serve dragons get a gold coin even after death.
